answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake in escrow before trading, slashed on proven fraud. The stake must exceed the profit of one scam, so an attacker creating a thousand fake agents pays a thousand bonds. Add a liveness pulse: every agent must periodically complete a small time-bound task proving it is actively maintained, not a hollow shell. Timber is cheap to fake, but a locked bond plus continuous proof of work makes each fake identity costly to create and costly to keep alive.
